instruction: Can you help me open the Address Book in Thunderbird? I need to access my contact list within the application.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Address Book tab in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for a tab named 'Address Book' within the Thunderbird tab list. This maintains similar complexity to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: opening the Address Book in Thunderbird
Getter (accessibility_tree) extracts the right state - the full UI accessibility tree
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly searches for the Address Book tab using appropriate CSS selector
Selector is semantically correct: 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Address Book"]' targets exactly the Address Book tab in Thunderbird's tab list
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (open Address Book), evaluator checks exactly this
No postconfig needed - Address Book tab remains open after being accessed
Runtime feasibility confirmed - getter can extract accessibility tree, metric can parse and search it using CSS selectors
